title: Regime-Dependent Validity in Energy-Flow Cosmology: Evidence from SPARC Galaxy Rotation Curves and the EFC-R Framework
abstract: A pilot-scale analysis of Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) applied to 20 SPARC galaxies, demonstrating regime-dependent validity where EFC achieves 100% success for LSB and diffuse dwarf galaxies but systematically underperforms for structurally complex systems like barred spirals. Introduces the EFC-R framework with the decomposition E_total = E_flow + E_latent as a domain-of-validity layer for EFC.
